tools.name: skill.ensure_installed
tools.description: Install a skill package from a supported source URL.
examples: Install the claude-api skill from a GitHub URL.

tools.name: inventory.describe
tools.description: Describe Roku's current local inventory, including installed skills, discoverable tools, and capability families, and reformat that inventory for the user.
examples: What skills and tools do you currently have?
List the installed skills and capability families as bullet points.
Reformat the available inventory as an unordered list.

tools.name: research.synthesize
tools.description: Research a topic, read context, and synthesize grounded findings.
examples: Summarize the latest requirements from the project docs.

tools.name: data.execute
tools.description: Transform datasets, aggregate metrics, or run structured data processing.
examples: Aggregate the experiment results into a compact table.

tools.name: review.assess
tools.description: Review a draft, assess correctness, and call out residual risks.
examples: Review the proposed plan and list the main risks.

tools.name: general.execute
tools.description: Answer directly when the request does not require an external tool or skill.
examples: Reply to a simple greeting or explain available capabilities.
